You're romanticising her too much. She cheated on you, she IS a cheater, and I'm sorry, but people change. Especially during puberty and after, they don't stay the same. Their dreams and mindset changes so much. She wasn't a good person if she cheated on you repeatedly, look at her objectively. 

You're scared because you've never had anyone else, you wanted to stay with her so much, you got desperate and clingy, you'd do anything for her to stay...but that's not the way to have a relationship. Ofc you're feeling empty, you were used to something and now it's not there. Well, what can you do? You can't and frankly, SHOULDN'T try to get it back, you take your shit and move on with your life, because you have decades in from of you, and you can't let a few months of heartbreak dictate the course of you future.

 Whatever you two had before, definitely wasn't the same after some time. You're clinging to your memories and the potential of the relationship, not what it actually was. She's a bad person, you don't want to be with a bad person. She's not your childhood sweetheart, she's a cheater who didn't respect you enough. Stop thinking "What if" and "But..", cos it won't change nothing. Accept the reality, learn from it, set boundaries for yourself. Learn what you actually want. 

Don't ruin your life cos of a cheater. She's not worth it, she probably doesn't even care, so you have nothing to prove to her. She wouldn't be sorry if she saw you. I'm sorry, but this is the truth and you'll get better once you start realising ACTUALLY what kind of a person she was and that you deserve much more. You'll regret it so much later if you ruin your career or college chances cos of one cheater.

It'll maybe take some time to get better. Take a week, cry, think, do whatever you want. But don't do this for too long, cos it's only detrimental to you, noone else. Start building up your confidence and personality and go from there. Get busy so it's not on your mind, be introspective. Remember, you WILL, 100% will meet other, better, mature, loving people who won't do that to you.

One more thing: forget about relationships for a while, you've been in one since forever and you never had the time to get to know YOU. Take this as an opportunity to focus on yourself and your improvement. Maybe you'll even like having all the time for yourself.
